attempts.summary: Deployed an inventory web application (Apache httpd serving /var/www/html/index.html with an inventory table) on node1, listening on TCP 8181, while keeping SELinux in Enforcing mode throughout. Configured httpd to Listen 8181, labeled port 8181 as http_port_t via semanage (required since 8181 was not in the default http_port_t list), opened the port in firewalld, and enabled/started httpd. Verified no SELinux AVC denials and HTTP 200 responses. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured a healthy baseline (boot_id 910dc564-...), triggered a native systemd reboot that disconnected the node, polled until reachable again, confirmed a new boot_id (e7f748e9-...) proving the restart occurred, and verified full post-restart recovery (SELinux still Enforcing, httpd active+enabled, port 8181 listening and firewalld-open, http_port_t label intact, app serving correct content, no AVC denials).
